en_US.scanner: Tool certification board. Trust was stamped into cutters, gloves and pump keys.
en_US.terminal: CERT BOARD: cutter head checked; sealant cartridge weighed; pressure glove dual-signed; pump key returned late; descent tools held until recheck.
en_US.audio: They did not pray before descent. They checked each other's tools.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Tool certification boards show colony culture without mysticism: trust came from repeated technical checks and custody marks.
en_US.external_site: The colony rituals in HECTON-8 are industrial: checklists, custody marks, pressure gloves and tool signatures.
